decisions.reason: Although this accelerator is less central than the firm's machinery platforms, it builds on its advisory offer and public home-page visibility, so in a growing firm management is likely to continue it rather than admit an early reversal.

Because the bio-based binder was presented as a flagship and linked to the firm's stated circular, lower-emission direction, escalation of commitment makes management reluctant to withdraw it within a year despite some fit risk with the core machinery business.

This decontamination plant is close to the firm's established technology base and was publicly highlighted as a flagship launch, so prior investment and strategic visibility strongly favor keeping it on the market.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant fits the core decentralized recycling proposition and was prominently launched on the home page, so a growing R&D-oriented machinery firm would usually persist with it rather than drop it quickly.
